about_the_game:
In Ephemeral Art: Shapeweaver, you can create interactive artwork with shapes — but you don't have to be an artist to have fun and enjoy the game. If you prefer, you can choose to simply interact with the other game elements for a different kind of experience entirely. Fling shapes around the canvas and combine a vast array of special effects to create a visual spectacle or a beautiful display of controlled chaos — the choice is yours. With endless possibilities and simple controls, this 2D world of color, motion, and shapes is your personal playground for creativity.

A Universe of Customization at Your Fingertips

Endless Shape Variations:

  • Choose from a wide variety of shapes, including circles, squares, triangles, stars, hearts, and many more.

  • Customize your shapes with a vast color palette, or let the game cycle through colors for a dynamic visual experience.

  • Adjust the size, style, and weight of your shapes. Make them bold, outlined, or even dotted for a unique look.

  • Apply different fill patterns and textures to give your creations a distinct personality.

Over 30 Animated Backgrounds:

  • Set the mood over 30 unique animated backgrounds to choose. Each background reacts to your clicks when placing shapes onto the canvas, creating a truly immersive experience. From tranquil starry nights to vibrant, pulsating nebulae, there's a background for every mood and style.

Unleash Your Inner Artist with Powerful Tools:

  • Grab Shape Tool: Take direct control of your creations! A simple click selects a shape, while a long press and drag allows you to select multiple shapes. Once selected, edit your shapes, move them to the perfect spot, or even fling them across the screen and watch them bounce off the canvas and other shapes.

  • Undo and Redo: Experiment without fear! Instantly reverse any action with the Undo and Redo buttons, giving you the freedom to explore every creative possibility.

  • Gravity and Physics: Bend the laws of physics to your will! Apply gravitational forces to your shapes and watch them interact in fascinating ways. Make them fall, orbit a central point, or float weightlessly in your digital canvas.

  • Breakable Shapes: Introduce an element of controlled chaos with breakable shapes. Watch as your creations shatter into pieces upon impact.

  • Fuse and Unfuse: Combine multiple shapes to create complex and intricate designs. The fuse tool allows you to merge shapes into a single, cohesive object, while the unfuse tool lets you break them apart again.

  • Custom Animations: Control the lifecycle of your shapes with customizable Entry and Dissolve effects. Have shapes bounce, spiral, or construct themselves onto the canvas, and watch them fade, pixelate, or shatter into pieces when they disappear.

  • Special Effects: Elevate your art with a plethora of special effects. Make your shapes glow with a neon aura, imbue them with elemental powers like fire and ice, or make them transparent for a ghostly effect.

Tailor Your Creative Space:

  • Flexible Interface: Make the game truly yours by customizing the user interface. Choose from a variety of themes, adjust text sizes and styles, and even change the position of the control panel to best suit your workflow.

  • Resizable & Pinnable Windows: Adjust the size of settings windows to fit your needs, and pin them to the screen for easy access while you continue to create and edit shapes on the canvas.

Sculpt Your Atmosphere:

  • Full Edit Mode: Take your creativity to the next level with Full Edit Mode. This feature pauses all shape animations and movements, allowing you to fine-tune your creations with precision and ease.

  • Canvas Settings: Perfect your masterpiece with a range of canvas settings. Apply special filters for extra visual flair, add a blurred background to make your shapes pop, and adjust the scene lighting to create the perfect atmosphere.

Personalize Your Experience:

  • Favorite Your Settings: With so many customization options, you're bound to find your perfect setup. Favorite your most-used settings for quick and easy access in any creative session.

  • Curate Your Soundtrack: Love a particular song? Add it to your favorites list to create a personalized playlist that perfectly matches your artistic vibe.

Game Modes for Every Playstyle

  • Regular Mode: Challenge yourself against the clock in this classic mode. Create as much as you can before time runs out and your masterpiece begins to dissolve.

  • Creative Mode: Unleash your creativity without any time pressure. This mode is a pure sandbox where you can experiment, explore, and create to your heart's content.

More Than a Game

  • Screensaver Mode: Activate Screensaver Mode to sit back, relax, and enjoy a seamless, ever-changing showcase of the game's animated backgrounds with multiple timer options. Or you can interact with the animated backgrounds by clicking on them for the full Screensaver Mode experience.

Features

  • Intuitive and easy-to-learn interface.

  • A vast array of shapes, colors, and customization options.

  • Over 30 unique animated backgrounds.

  • Powerful tools including Grab Shape, Undo/Redo, gravity settings, breakable shapes, and shape fusion.

  • Customizable Entry and Dissolve animations for your shapes.

  • A wide variety of special shape effects to make your creations pop.

  • Fully customizable user interface, including themes, text styles, window management, and layout options.

  • Various canvas settings like special filters, blurred backgrounds, and scene lighting.

  • A dedicated "Full Edit Mode" for complete control over your creations.

  • Screensaver Mode allows you to enjoy the animated backgrounds with ease.

  • Favoriting system for quick access to your preferred settings and songs.

  • Two distinct game modes to suit your playstyle.

  • A chill collection of music to accompany your creative journey.

Whether you want to create a breathtaking work of 2D art with shapes or just have fun playing with physics, colors, and animated backgrounds, Ephemeral Art: Shapeweaver is the perfect digital canvas for you. Get ready to shape your imagination!
